key_objects.name_zh: Proposition 2.5 的有限正则性版本
key_objects.name_en: finite-regularity version of Proposition 2.5
key_objects.statement: The estimate in Proposition 2.5 only requires finite differentiability: the constants can be controlled by finite C^N norms, a lower bound for |det ∇²Φ|, and the support diameter.

key_objects.name_zh: Hessian 秩至少 m 时的衰减
key_objects.name_en: decay under Hessian rank at least m

key_objects.name_zh: 曲面承载测度的 Fourier 变换
key_objects.name_en: Fourier transform of surface-carried measures
key_objects.description: Fourier decay of smooth measures supported on hypersurfaces is controlled by the principal curvatures.

key_objects.name_zh: 超曲面的局部图表示
key_objects.name_en: local graph representation of a hypersurface

key_objects.name_zh: 归一化定义函数
key_objects.name_en: normalized defining function
key_objects.description: A defining function ρ for M is normalized by |∇ρ|=1 on M.

key_objects.name_zh: 曲率形式（第二基本形式）
key_objects.name_en: curvature form / second fundamental form
key_objects.formula: Σ_{1≤k,j≤d} ξ_k ξ_j ∂²ρ/(∂x_k∂x_j)(x), restricted to tangent vectors

key_objects.name_zh: 主曲率
key_objects.name_en: principal curvatures
key_objects.description: After diagonalizing the Hessian of the graphing function, the eigenvalues λ_j are the principal curvatures.

key_objects.name_zh: Gauss 曲率（总曲率）
key_objects.name_en: Gauss curvature / total curvature
key_objects.description: The product of the principal curvatures, equivalently the determinant of the curvature matrix.

key_objects.name_zh: 单位球面的曲率
key_objects.name_en: curvature of the unit sphere
key_objects.description: For the unit sphere in R^d all principal curvatures equal 1 (with the chosen orientation).

key_objects.name_zh: 双曲抛物面的曲率
key_objects.name_en: curvature of a hyperbolic paraboloid
key_objects.description: The hypersurface x_3=x_1^2-x_2^2 has nonvanishing principal curvatures of opposite signs.

key_objects.name_zh: 圆锥的曲率
key_objects.name_en: curvature of the circular cone
key_objects.description: The cone x_d^2=|x'|^2, x_d≠0, has d-2 identical nonvanishing principal curvatures at each point.

key_objects.name_zh: 诱导 Lebesgue 曲面测度
key_objects.name_en: induced Lebesgue surface measure
key_objects.description: The surface measure dσ is characterized by the collar-limit definition around M.

key_objects.name_zh: 图坐标下的曲面测度
key_objects.name_en: surface measure in graph coordinates

key_objects.name_zh: 光滑密度的曲面承载测度
key_objects.name_en: surface-carried measure with smooth density
key_objects.description: dμ=ψ dσ, where ψ is C∞ and compactly supported on the hypersurface.

key_objects.name_zh: 非零 Gauss 曲率下的 Fourier 衰减
key_objects.name_en: Fourier decay under nonvanishing Gauss curvature
key_objects.statement: If M has nonvanishing Gauss curvature on supp dμ, then |dμ^(ξ)|=O(|ξ|^{-(d-1)/2}).

key_objects.name_zh: 曲面承载测度的衰减阶
key_objects.name_en: decay rate of a surface-carried measure

key_objects.name_zh: 至少 m 个非零主曲率时的衰减
key_objects.name_en: decay with at least m nonzero principal curvatures
key_objects.statement: If at least m principal curvatures are nonzero on supp dμ, then |dμ^(ξ)|=O(|ξ|^{-m/2}).

key_objects.name_zh: 曲面测度 Fourier 变换的局部振荡积分表示
key_objects.name_en: local oscillatory-integral representation of surface Fourier transform

key_objects.name_zh: 频率空间的临界锥与辅助区域
key_objects.name_en: critical and subsidiary frequency regions
key_objects.description: Split frequency space into |ξ_d|≥c|ξ'|, handled by nondegenerate stationary phase, and |ξ_d|<c|ξ'|, handled by nonstationary rapid decay.

key_objects.name_zh: 曲率边界区域示性函数的 Fourier 衰减
key_objects.name_en: Fourier decay of the indicator of a curved domain
key_objects.statement: If M=∂Ω has nonvanishing Gauss curvature, then χ_Ω^(ξ)=O(|ξ|^{-(d+1)/2}).

key_objects.name_zh: 示性函数边界项的振荡积分表示
key_objects.name_en: oscillatory representation for a boundary piece of a domain indicator

key_objects.name_zh: 曲面衰减定理的有限正则性
key_objects.name_en: finite regularity for the surface-decay results
key_objects.statement: The results of Section 3 remain valid if M is only of class C^{d+2}.

key_objects.name_zh: 回到平均算子
key_objects.name_en: Return to the averaging operator
key_objects.description: Use surface Fourier decay plus analytic-family interpolation to obtain Sobolev smoothing and L^p→L^q improvement.

key_objects.name_zh: 一般曲面平均算子
key_objects.name_en: general surface averaging operator

key_objects.name_zh: 曲面平均算子的平滑与 Lp-Lq 改善
key_objects.name_en: smoothing and Lp-Lq improvement for curved averages
key_objects.statement: If Gauss curvature is nonzero on supp dμ: (a) A:L²→L²_k with k=(d-1)/2; (b) A:L^p→L^q with p=(d+1)/d and q=d+1.

key_objects.name_zh: 平均算子的 Riesz 图
key_objects.name_en: Riesz diagram for the averaging operator
key_objects.statement: The Lp→Lq boundedness region is the closed triangle with vertices (0,0), (1,1), and (d/(d+1),1/(d+1)).

key_objects.name_zh: 平均算子 A 的 Riesz 图
key_objects.name_en: Riesz diagram of the map A in Corollary 4.2
key_objects.caption: Riesz diagram of the map A in Corollary 4.2

key_objects.name_zh: 至少 m 个非零主曲率时的平均算子结论
key_objects.name_en: averaging result with at least m nonzero principal curvatures
key_objects.statement: With at least m nonzero principal curvatures, k=m/2, p=(m+2)/(m+1), and q=m+2.

key_objects.name_zh: 解析算子族
key_objects.name_en: analytic family of operators
key_objects.description: A family T_s on a vertical strip is required to give bounded continuous scalar pairings on the closed strip and analytic pairings in the interior, together with endpoint Lp→Lq estimates.

key_objects.name_zh: 解析算子族的 Riesz 插值
key_objects.name_en: Riesz interpolation for an analytic family of operators
key_objects.statement: For c=(1-θ)a+θb, the intermediate operator T_c is bounded L^p→L^q with reciprocal exponents interpolated linearly from the two boundary estimates.

key_objects.name_zh: 平均算子证明的插值架构
key_objects.name_en: interpolation architecture for the averaging operator
key_objects.description: The proof interpolates an L¹→L∞ estimate for an integrated version of A with an L²→L² estimate for a differentiated version; A appears at the intermediate parameter.

key_objects.name_zh: 解析核族 K_s
key_objects.name_en: analytic kernel family K_s

key_objects.name_zh: K_s Fourier 变换的解析延拓与一致有界性
key_objects.name_en: analytic continuation and uniform Fourier bound for K_s
key_objects.statement: K_s^ is analytically continuable to Re(s)≥-(d-1)/2 and is uniformly bounded in ξ on the strip -(d-1)/2≤Re(s)≤1.

key_objects.name_zh: K_s Fourier 变换的一致估计
key_objects.name_en: uniform bound for the Fourier transform of K_s

key_objects.name_zh: 一维辅助积分 I_s(ρ)
key_objects.name_en: one-dimensional auxiliary integral I_s(rho)

key_objects.name_zh: I_s(ρ) 的解析延拓与衰减
key_objects.name_en: analytic continuation and decay of I_s(rho)
key_objects.statement: I_s extends analytically to Re(s)>-N-1; |I_s(ρ)|≤c_s(1+|ρ|)^{-Re(s)} for -N-1<Re(s)≤1, and I_0(ρ)=N!F(0).

key_objects.name_zh: Lemma 4.6 的分部积分与频率分区证明
key_objects.name_en: integration-by-parts and frequency split in Lemma 4.6
key_objects.description: The proof first integrates by parts N+1 times for analytic continuation, then splits with η(uρ) versus 1-η(uρ) to prove the high-|ρ| estimate. The proof continues on PDF 361.
